Description

I was randomly reminded the other night about Join/Leave Notifications after having completely forgotten about their existence. They haven't worked for me since they were added. I have never had them disabled or anything, but they never work. I've tried all the troubleshooting I could find on the VRChat Canny and Discord, but nothing works to fix the issue. From what I've read, I'm not the only person who has experienced them vanishing and never coming back. It would be nice to have them again cause I remember being very excited about their implementation back in the day!

Reproduction Steps

It's been so long since I've seen Join/Leave Notifications, I have no idea how I would be able to replicate them completely disappearing :( I've tried everything to troubleshoot, and they have never reappeared.
